decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing creatures that can be searched for and put into play at instant speed to create a versatile toolbox of options. By using cards like Chord of Calling and Summoner's Pact, the player can tutor for specific creatures needed in a given situation. This allows for flexibility and adaptability in response to the opponent's actions. The deck also includes protection and disruption elements, such as Sylvan Safekeeper and Teferi, Time Raveler, to further control the game and ensure the combo pieces can be used effectively.

This deck focuses on aggressive tactics, utilizing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Amped Raptor to quickly overwhelm opponents. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional firepower. The inclusion of Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge offer direct damage spells to help finish off opponents. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to hinder opponents' strategies. The mana base is set up to provide the necessary colors while also maximizing efficiency. Overall, the deck aims to deal quick and consistent damage to secure victories.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers and enchantments to help maintain board control and further increase pressure on the opponent. With a mix of powerful creatures and powerful spells, this Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its fast-paced and proactive gameplay. It also includes a companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, to provide additional value and flexibility in deckbuilding. Overall, the deck is designed to apply constant pressure and end the game quickly.

This Modern deck focuses on assembling UrzaTron to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes control elements like Trinisphere, Kozilek's Command, and All Is Dust to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also controlling the board. The deck also includes powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to close out the game. The synergy between the artifact lands and Karn, the Great Creator allows for versatile gameplay and the ability to tutor for important artifacts like The One Ring and Karn's Sylex.

The main idea of the deck is to use aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent and overwhelm them before they can set up their own game plan. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an additional threat to the deck and helps generate mana in the late game. The deck also utilizes cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's strategy and take advantage of the aggressive nature of the Boros color combination. Overall, the focus is on maintaining a fast and relentless pace to secure victory.
